title: Warm Juicy Brazilian Potato Braised
description: Fermented, juicy, romantic Brazilian dish featuring russet potato, stir-fry, ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the kombu and 2 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the potatoes for 45 minutes, or until they're tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in some cilantro.
Serve the potatoes hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
